meta.name: motif-analysis
meta.description: Guide for de novo and known motif enrichment analysis of ENCODE ChIP-seq and ATAC-seq peaks using HOMER and MEME Suite. Use when users need to discover TF binding motifs in peaks, validate ChIP-seq targets, or find co-binding partners. Trigger on: motif analysis, HOMER, MEME, de novo motif, motif enrichment, findMotifsGenome, AME, MEME-ChIP, known motif, TF binding motif, co-factor, motif discovery.

copy.tagline: 分析ChIP-seq和ATAC-seq峰中的转录因子结合基序
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在分析ENCODE峰数据，需要发现或验证转录因子结合基序。
copy.tagline_en: Analyze transcription factor binding motifs in ChIP-seq and ATAC-seq peaks
copy.fit_line_en: For you if analyzing ENCODE peak data to discover or validate transcription factor binding motifs.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能指导你使用 HOMER 和 MEME Suite 对 ENCODE 的 ChIP-seq 或 ATAC-seq 峰进行从头和已知基序富集分析，包括输入准备、运行工具和结果解读。
howto.when: 当你询问基序分析、HOMER、MEME、从头基序发现、基序富集等关键词，或需要验证 ChIP-seq 靶标、寻找共结合伙伴时触发。

say.text: 帮我用 HOMER 分析 CTCF ChIP-seq 峰中的基序。
用 MEME-ChIP 对 ATAC-seq 峰进行已知基序富集分析。
say.note: Claude 会提供 meme-chip 命令和参数建议。

say.text: 解释 HOMER 结果中已知基序的 p 值含义。
say.note: Claude 会说明超几何检验和多重检验注意事项。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can guide you through de novo and known motif enrichment analysis of ENCODE ChIP-seq or ATAC-seq peaks using HOMER and MEME Suite, including input preparation, tool execution, and result interpretation.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask about motif analysis, HOMER, MEME, de novo motif discovery, motif enrichment, or need to validate ChIP-seq targets or find co-binding partners.

say_en.text: Run HOMER motif analysis on my CTCF ChIP-seq peaks.
say_en.note: Claude will guide you through input preparation and findMotifsGenome.pl.

say_en.text: Perform known motif enrichment on ATAC-seq peaks using MEME-ChIP.
say_en.note: Claude will provide the meme-chip command and parameters.

say_en.text: Explain the p-value interpretation in HOMER known motif results.
say_en.note: Claude will explain hypergeometric test and multiple testing caveats.
